title: Thermodynamics and statistical physics
prerequisites: P1, M2, M7; P7a for quantum statistics.
purpose: Derive thermodynamic quantities from microscopic state counting and partition functions.

blocks.deliverable: Solve energy balance problems with clear sign conventions.
Derive a relation from an appropriate potential.
Calculate a finite state partition function.
Week 7 midterm; derive energy and fluctuations.
Compare Bose and Fermi occupation numbers.
Analyze a simple curve and distinguish finite size behavior.
Submit a regime comparison and complete the final.

project: Compare classical and quantum statistics in one simple model and explain the valid temperature regime.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
